guitar.guitaristsText: Phil Collen / Vivian Campbell (formerly Steve Clark)
guitar.modelsText: Jackson / Ibanez (Phil Collen signature Jackson PC1)
guitar.evidence: Phil Collen has a long-running Jackson PC1 signature model; Steve Clark (original guitarist) was known for Gibson Les Paul/Jackson.
guitar.notes: Filled from unknown with reasonably well documented info.

tone.target: bright layered 80s hard-rock crunch with chorus sheen
tone.profile: bright layered 80s hard-rock crunch with chorus sheen
tone.summary: A bright, layered signal chain using a pre-amp boost for tight crunch, followed by an AC30 TB/UK Vintage 4x12 combo to capture the polished 80s sound, enhanced with Chorus and Digital Delay.
corrections: Replace modern high-gain with Marshall-style crunch
Use polished 80s sheen, not Rectifier gain

rig.name: Def Leppard - Pour Some Sugar On Me - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and tighten the overall sound.
Provide the tight, mid-focused crunch and boost needed for 80s rock rhythm playing.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used to simulate a classic British overdrive/boost (like an early Tube Screamer or similar) without adding excessive modern saturation.

blocks.purpose: Add grit and punch to the crunch layer without resorting to modern high-gain saturation.
blocks.gap: The RAT is chosen for its classic, aggressive mid-range bite, fitting the 'hot-rodded Marshall' vibe better than pure fuzz or Muff-style distortion.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic British clean/crunch tone (Plexi/Marshall) required for 80s polished rock.
Provide the classic British cabinet voicing and necessary mid-range punch.
Implement the core 'chorus sheen' and polished stereo texture essential to 80s pop-rock.
Add a subtle, polished stereo echo effect without muddying the main rhythm tone.
blocks.gap: The delay is kept minimal to maintain tightness and polish.

blocks.purpose: Provide a subtle sense of space and polish without sounding overly wet or dramatic.
blocks.gap: A light Room reverb is preferred over Plate/Spring to maintain the 'polished' 80s stadium feel.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and mid-range punch for a more authentic 80s polished sound.

proposals.reason: Enhance the classic British mid-range punch and polish.
